actual_file_scope: Entire actual candidate, proof and final scope remark freshly read. No mathematical or typographical correction.
checks: For odd m dividing q+1, a primitive mth root has norm one. The shift X and diagonal clock Y preserve the displayed Hermitian form, have order m and determinant one, including characteristic two.

XY=zeta^(-1)YX gives a scalar in the actual SU kernel. If X^aY^b is scalar, the permutation of coordinate lines forces a=0, and the diagonal entries then force b=0. Thus the projective subgroup is exactly (Z/m)^2.
The actual chosen lifts have cocycle c((a,b),(a_prime,b_prime))=zeta^(b*a_prime), with no wraparound correction because X^m=Y^m=1. Its pointwise mth power is one.

Every multiplicative coboundary on the abelian domain with trivial coefficient action is symmetric. The alternating commutator ratio zeta^(-1) therefore proves exact order m in H2 with the FULL K^times coefficients; no unjustified coefficient-group injection is used.
Restriction of the projective-semilinear scalar extension has trivial field character and gives exactly the same class.
For p=2, m=2^f+1 is odd and unbounded. For odd p and even f, p^f=1 mod8, hence m=(p^f+1)/2 is odd, prime to p and unbounded. Restricting to m>=5 is inside the existing simple unitary range.
The final remark correctly distinguishes failure of an absolute algebraic scalar-exponent shortcut from a geometric Brauer realization on a fixed surface or a counterexample to a hereditary count.
